integrity: Analytic support-line area calculation and eighth-derivative remainder proof; accompanying finite-precision checker corroborates but does not certify infinite quantifiers. Definitive historical priority is not independently certified.
scientific_limitations: Requires a fixed strictly convex planar body with C^8 support function and positive curvature radius.
Only the uniform-normal-phase expected area is expanded for general bodies; no claim about best circumscribed polygons or a complete distribution.
The sign of the fourth-order correction may be negative while every actual area excess is nonnegative.
No bound uniform over frequencies growing with n is asserted.
title: A fourth-order curvature-gradient signature in equiangular tangent-polygon approximation
